trigger: Inside the hangar: the stranded Ironwood recovery detail.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The hangar. A fire in a drum. Six soldiers in sleeping bags, too thin. One stands up with a rifle.

nodes.speaker: sfc_brandt
nodes.text: Sergeant First Class Brandt, Task Force Ironwood. We're tasked to secure this facility. Turn around.

nodes.speaker: sfc_brandt
nodes.text: We've been out here three weeks. Nobody's called. We ate the last MRE Sunday. So turn around.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Brandt. It's Nadia. Engineer Two. It's over, Jim. Kessler's holed up in a rail yard. There's no mission.

nodes.speaker: sfc_brandt
nodes.text: ...Ruiz? God. Okay. Okay. Stand down, everybody. It's Ruiz.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Six rifles. Six starving kids holding them.

nodes.speaker: sfc_brandt
nodes.text: Ruiz's ID. She's alive? ...Fine. Fine. We're not shooting anyone with Ruiz's ID.

nodes.speaker: sfc_brandt
nodes.text: [He takes it. His hands shake.] ...Okay. We'll talk. Talk while we eat.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: It's short and ugly and it should never have happened. You find their logbook after.

nodes.speaker: sfc_brandt
nodes.text: The spares are in cage four. We didn't go in the main building. Nobody goes in there. You'll see why.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Cage four. Pelican cases. Shielded control modules, PLC cards, sealed floodlight heads. Everything Galena needs.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Reyne is standing at the door of the main building. 'You should see the holds. You should know what's out there.'
